case_name: Mehak And Anr vs State Of Haryana And Ors

parties.respondent_defendant: State of Haryana and others (government agency)

facts_of_case: Petitioners Mehak and Rohit Kumar got married against the wishes of their parents. They approached the court seeking protection from physical harm.

legal_principles.principle: Nobody can be allowed to cause physical harm to the petitioners.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, this petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2 - Superintendent of Police, Kurukshetra to ensure that no physical harm is caused to the petitioners at the hands of respondents No.4 and 5 or persons claiming under them.

legal_principles.principle: Marriage between two individuals under the age of 21 is not as per requirement of Section 5 of Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: Admittedly, petitioner No.2 - Rohit Kumar is less than 21 years and the marriage is not as per requirement of Section 5 of Hindu Marriage Act.

outcome.final_order: Direction to ensure no physical harm is caused to petitioners at hands of respondents or persons claiming under them. Marriage not validated and shall not affect any civil or criminal action.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nobody can be allowed to cause physical harm
use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for protection from physical harm
